qbp.processing: Remove signal peptide residues 1-22; renumber the remaining 226 residues from 1. Exact match to the requested sequence. No ligand or water.
qbp.starting_state: Closed-like AlphaFold model; not an experimental closed structure.
qbp.reference_processing: Protein chain A only. Preserve residue numbering. References have L23 instead of K23; 1GGG lacks residues 1-4 and 225-226, 1WDN lacks residues 1-3.

chorismate_mutase.processing: Wild-type trimer A/B/C, resolved residues 1-117; omit unresolved 118-127 and add terminal OXT to residue 117. Transplant substrate from the aligned Arg90Cit complex. Retain one bridging water and minimize the prepared reactant. This is an assembled model, not an unmodified crystal structure.
chorismate_mutase.ligand: Chorismate dianion, ISJ, formal charge -2, singlet.
chorismate_mutase.ml_selection: resn ISJ or resn HOH or (chain A and resi 63+74+75) or (chain B and resi 7+78+90+108)
